name: Laughing Fate
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level: jester 1

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action
Components: (not included in source material)

EFFECT

Range: close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target: one creature
Duration: 1 round
Saving Throw: Will negates; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

You curse the target with a moment of poor luck. The next time the target makes an attack roll, it must roll twice and take the worse result.
